dashboard.title: Dashboards
dashboard.description: A single interface where all the important data is visible in one place. Finances, orders, customer data, statistics. Everything updates automatically, nothing needs to be collected manually. Accessible from anywhere, including mobile. The layout and content are fully customisable.

ai.title: AI Solutions
ai.description: Exists in two forms. Externally: built into the company website, it automatically answers incoming questions — knows prices, opening hours, services, in multiple languages, around the clock. What it cannot answer, it forwards. Internally: supports work within the company — creates summaries, drafts emails, processes documents, organises data.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: In any company there are countless small tasks that always go the same way. An email comes in, the data needs to be extracted, entered into a spreadsheet, and a confirmation sent back. An order comes through the webshop, the team needs to be notified and the stock updated. A form is filled in, the answers need to be saved. These steps can be connected so they run automatically one after another, without human intervention. It only needs to be set up once, then it runs on its own.

websites.title: Websites
websites.description: A modern website that looks good on any screen size — computer, tablet, phone. It loads fast, search engines find it. It also works in multiple languages. The content can be edited through a separate interface, changes appear immediately.
